pairs.subject: cross-provider-benchmark-operations
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/resilience/detect.rs:5 Searches for scorecard, prompt_variant, thinking_budget, entitlement, and anonymize found nothing in this context or the repo, and the detector is a pure function over extractor sketches with no model in the decision, so it does not operate a cross-provider benchmark matrix.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/resilience/detect.rs:13 The unit of work is an extraction verdict over documents already fetched, not a paid benchmark job that must enqueue, report progress, and cancel.
crates/core/src/resilience/preview.rs:3 The caller-facing surface is an enforce preview for source health, not a benchmark declaration that names target axes and the meaning of an omitted knob.
crates/core/src/resilience/mod.rs:46 Detection spends no paid model calls, so there is no matrix estimate or operator ceiling to enforce.
crates/core/src/resilience/preview.rs:15 Preview replays stored extraction-health states and does not pick a cheapest configuration against a best target.
crates/core/src/retention.rs:24 Retention pins scrape artifact bodies by age and live readers; it does not sample, anonymize, or freeze an eval dataset.
crates/core/src/resilience/detect.rs:6 Reproducibility means replaying a stored source_runs row, not a sampled, best-effort, or exact stamp on generation and judging.
crates/core/src/resilience/detect.rs:182 A 429 is evidence the scrape fetch layer failed, not that a purchased model allowance ran out.
crates/core/src/doctor.rs:6 Doctor joins store-integrity promises and does not cluster low-scoring benchmark cases into prompt or routing actions.
crates/core/src/resilience/sketch.rs:3 Sketches summarize extracted field distributions, not an ordered difficulty ladder on eval cases.
crates/core/src/resilience/store.rs:4 Persisted rows are source health and field sketches, with no per-cell handicap beside a comparative score.
crates/core/src/resilience/invariants.rs:12 Invariants are mined field regularities; there is no reasoning-effort or thinking-budget axis on a model spec.
crates/core/src/resilience/mod.rs:407 The only residency in this context is peak HTML DOM memory, not accelerator placement of a self-hosted model.
crates/core/src/resilience/mod.rs:21 Nothing here declares a provider, model, and prompt-variant matrix or scores the same cases across targets.

pairs.registryProposal: entitlement-exhaustion-is-not-ill-health lists 'a rate limit keeps reopening the same target's breaker' in use_when, which matches a scrape fetch gate that files HTTP 429 as fetch failure; the procedure requires a purchased allowance on a benchmark target, so that bullet is wider than the subject.
